people.nameZh: 古斯塔夫斯·澤姆加爾斯

body.zh-Hant: 澤姆加爾斯1871年8月12日生於杰克斯特（Džūkste）鄉區，1899年畢業於莫斯科大學法學院，其後在里加擔任律師。1901年他當選里加拉脫維亞工人與工匠協會「Jonatans」主席，1905年任《Jaunā Dienas Lapa》報主編，並參與創建拉脫維亞民主黨。
body.en: Gustavs Zemgals was born on 12 August 1871 in the Džūkste rural district and graduated from the Faculty of Law of Moscow University in 1899, then worked in Riga as an attorney. In 1901 he was elected chairman of the Riga Latvian workers' and craftsmen's association 'Jonatans', in 1905 he was editor in chief of the newspaper Jaunā Dienas Lapa, and he took part in founding the Latvian Democratic Party.

heading.en: Riga mayoralty and the proclamation of independence

body.zh-Hant: 1917年4月23日澤姆加爾斯被推選為里加市長（pilsētas galva）。1918年11月18日他在民族劇院主持宣告拉脫維亞獨立的典禮，1918至1919年任拉脫維亞人民議會副議長；1919年7月8日他再度被任命為里加市長。至於他任市長到何時，總統府兩頁說法不一：英文頁寫1919至1927年，拉脫維亞文頁摘要寫1918至1920年。
body.en: On 23 April 1917 Zemgals was chosen as mayor (city head) of Riga. On 18 November 1918 he chaired the solemn act at the National Theatre proclaiming Latvian independence, and in 1918-1919 he was Vice-President of the People's Council; on 8 July 1919 he was again appointed mayor of Riga. The two pages of the President's Chancery differ on how long he served as mayor: the English page says 1919 to 1927, the Latvian page's summary says 1918 to 1920.

body.zh-Hant: 1921至1923年澤姆加爾斯是議會（Saeima）議員。1921年6月10日至1923年1月26日，他在梅耶羅維茨斯（Zigfrīds Anna Meierovics）總理的內閣中擔任國防部長（apsardzības ministrs）。
body.en: From 1921 to 1923 Zemgals was a member of the Saeima. From 10 June 1921 to 26 January 1923 he was Minister of Defence (apsardzības ministrs) in the cabinet of Prime Minister Zigfrīds Anna Meierovics.

body.zh-Hant: 1927年4月8日，議會在多輪投票後以73票對23票選澤姆加爾斯為國家總統，他當時56歲。1929年5月28日他前往斯德哥爾摩進行國事訪問，瑞典國王古斯塔夫五世於6月29日回訪拉脫維亞。他的總統任期於1930年4月9日屆滿，他堅決拒絕再度參選。
body.en: On 8 April 1927 the Saeima elected Zemgals State President after repeated voting, by 73 votes to 23; he was 56. On 28 May 1929 he made a state visit to Stockholm, and King Gustav V of Sweden returned the visit to Latvia on 29 June 1929. His presidential term expired on 9 April 1930, and he flatly refused to run again.

body.zh-Hant: 卸任後澤姆加爾斯在第四屆議會任議員。1931年12月11日他受邀出任財政部長，但因預算與財政問題和其他閣員及議會委員會意見不合，不久即請辭；拉脫維亞文頁另寫他1931至1932年任財政部長。1933年他當選波羅的海聯盟（Ūnija Baltijas sadarbībai）主席。他於1939年1月6日在里加去世，享年65歲。
body.en: After leaving the presidency Zemgals sat in the fourth Saeima. On 11 December 1931 he was invited to become Minister of Finance but soon resigned over budget and financial disagreements with other cabinet members and the parliamentary committee; the Latvian page also gives his term as finance minister as 1931-1932. In 1933 he was elected president of the Union for Baltic Cooperation. He died in Riga on 6 January 1939 at the age of 65.

body.zh-Hant: 維拉羅埃爾（Gualberto Villarroel López）1908年12月15日生於維拉里韋羅（Villa Rivero）。他原是默默無聞的軍官，擔任改革派軍事學院的教官，也是祕密民族主義軍人團體「祖國理由」（Razón de Patria，簡稱RADEPA）的核心人物。他與民族革命運動（MNR）結盟，發動政變推翻佩尼亞蘭達將軍（Enrique Peñaranda）的政府，成為玻利維亞總統（1943–1946）。
body.en: Gualberto Villarroel López was born on 15 December 1908 in Villa Rivero. A virtually unknown military officer, he was an instructor at the reformist military college and a key figure in the secret nationalist military lodge Razón de Patria (RADEPA). Allied with the Nationalist Revolutionary Movement (MNR), he seized power in a coup against the administration of General Enrique Peñaranda and became president of Bolivia (1943-1946).

body.zh-Hant: 維拉羅埃爾政府的民意基礎主要靠MNR，期間通過了重要的礦工勞動立法。1945年政府召開第一屆全國原住民大會，約千名原住民領袖與會；其後強迫無償勞役（pongueaje）被廢除，其他改革也被提出，但相關立法從未實施。另一方面，1944年一次未遂政變後，政權處決了多名反對派領袖。
body.en: The government depended largely on the MNR for popular support, and important mine labor legislation was passed. In 1945 it organized the First National Indian Congress, attended by a thousand Indian leaders; as a result the unpaid labor service pongueaje was abolished and other reforms were advanced, though the legislation was never enacted. On the other hand, after a failed coup in 1944 the regime executed various opposition leaders.

body.zh-Hant: 1946年，一場教師罷工演變成暴力衝突，群眾衝進總統府，把維拉羅埃爾吊死在鄰近廣場的路燈柱上。他於1946年7月21日去世。該政權以社會改革嘗試著稱，並有MNR參與。
body.en: In 1946 a teachers' strike turned violent, a mob stormed the presidential palace and hanged Villarroel from a lamppost in the adjoining plaza. He died on 21 July 1946. His regime is noted for its attempts at social reform and for the participation of the MNR.

people.name: Rafael de la Cruz Franco Ojeda

heading.zh-Hant: 查科邊界衝突中的軍官
heading.en: Officer in the Chaco border dispute

body.zh-Hant: 1928年12月，少校拉斐爾·佛朗哥（Rafael Franco）率領巴拉圭部隊攻擊玻利維亞控制下的凡瓜爾迪亞堡（Fortín Vanguardia）。這次行動雖達成眼前目標，卻被亞松森政府否認；他被視為難以駕馭的急躁軍官，因而失去指揮權，直到1932年邊界爭端演變成全面戰爭才被召回。
body.en: In December 1928 Paraguayan forces led by Major Rafael Franco attacked the Bolivian-held Fortín Vanguardia. Although the action achieved its immediate aim, the government in Asunción repudiated it; regarded as an uncontrollable hothead, Franco lost his command and was recalled only in 1932, when the border dispute turned into open war.

heading.en: The Chaco War and the February 1936 coup

body.zh-Hant: 1932年起的戰爭中，佛朗哥的軍事表現受到注意，同時他公開策動反對艾亞拉（Eusebio Ayala）的自由黨政權。戰事結束後，已是上校的他於1936年2月17日率軍發動兵變，推翻艾亞拉，並被擁立為獨裁者。他宣布以土地重分配、勞工權利與國家主導政策為重點的改革方案，但1937年8月被效忠自由黨的軍事領袖推翻。
body.en: Franco's military exploits in the war that began in 1932 were noteworthy, and he openly maneuvered against the Liberal regime of Eusebio Ayala. With the fighting over, Colonel Franco led the armed forces in a mutiny on 17 February 1936 that swept Ayala from office and installed him as dictator. He announced a reform program focused on land redistribution, workers' rights and statist politics, but was overthrown in August 1937 by military leaders loyal to the Liberal Party.

heading.en: Exile, the Febrerista Party and civil war

body.zh-Hant: 下台後佛朗哥流亡國外，但在巴拉圭革命圈中仍有影響力。他在流亡中組織了二月革命黨（Partido Revolucionario Febrerista），支持者包括學生、工人、部分軍官與左右翼意識形態者。1946年，獨裁者莫里尼戈邀他回國參加聯合政府，計畫未成；一年後局勢演變成內戰，他指揮叛軍作戰，短時間後兵敗，再度流亡。
body.en: After his fall Franco went into exile but remained influential in revolutionary circles within Paraguay. From exile he organized the Febrerista Party, which drew support from students, workers, some officers and ideologues of both left and right. In 1946 the dictator Higínio Morínigo invited him back to join a coalition government, which failed to materialize; a year later the situation degenerated into civil war, in which Franco commanded the rebel forces but soon had to accept defeat and go into exile again.

body.zh-Hant: 此後二月黨仍保有一定影響力，但運動逐漸放棄早期的激進路線，轉向社會民主主義。史壯斯納（Alfredo Stroessner）執政期間，佛朗哥數度應邀自流亡中回國，二月黨在1964年後被有限度地允許參與選舉，只作為象徵性的反對黨。佛朗哥於1973年去世，二月黨從此缺乏有力的領導人。
body.en: The Febreristas retained some influence, but over the years the movement abandoned its early radicalism for a social democratic line. Under Alfredo Stroessner, Franco returned several times from exile, and after 1964 the party was permitted, in a limited way, to contest elections as little more than token opposition. Franco died in 1973, leaving the Febreristas without viable leadership.
